Employee onboarding and offboarding

Every arrival and departure follows its checklist: 89 built-in tasks across 5 profiles (all staff, office, field, manager, apprentice or intern), each with an owner (HR, manager, IT, facilities, the employee) and a due date from day −15 to day +90. Tasks of the week by owner, equipment handed over and returned, printable summary per person. Minimal personal data, no HR software integration.
